summary: Enhance your skills in sustainability reporting with our comprehensive training course. Learn to effectively use performance indicators for impactful reporting.
lede: Sustainability and CSR training covers how organizations identify priority issues and measure performance to support decisions. Designed for professionals working in sustainability, ESG, reporting, or performance measurement, it builds practical skills in selecting material topics, designing indicators, collecting and checking data, analysing trends, and communicating evidence clearly to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly deal with sustainability, ESG, reporting, or performance measurement.
modules: Foundations of Sustainability and ESG Reporting
Designing Sustainability Performance Indicators and KPIs
Reporting Sustainability Performance to Different Stakeholders
Social Impact, Inclusion, and SDG-linked Indicators
Using Sustainability Performance for Strategy and Decision Making
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of sustainability concepts and experience with organizational reporting or performance measurement. Familiarity with ESG frameworks is beneficial but not required.
